intent: Every change reaches main only through a pull request the owner has reviewed and approved. Changes are small, so each one gets its own branch and its own review. These rules are enforced by the agent and a local pre-push hook.

rules.statement: Each change gets its own branch, named with a conventional-commit type prefix, for example feat/<slug>, fix/<slug> or chore/<slug>.
Never commit or push to main directly.
Open a pull request when the branch is ready, then stop. The description states what changed, the verification evidence, and anything uncertain.
Merge only after the owner approves in chat or on the pull request. Use a squash merge with a conventional-commit title, then delete the branch.
The agent never uses git push --no-verify or disables the pre-push hook. Only the owner may bypass it.
